title: Vault: Facts, Pending Review and Entities indexes (#1388)
body:
Fixes #1388.

Builds on #1395 (#1387); merge that first.

I added three generated views in Views/: Facts Index.md (active facts linked to their notes), Pending Review.md (pending facts with links; it says plainly a link never approves anything) and Entities Index.md (grouped by the ontology's types with an Unclassified group, aliases shown, using the #1387 entity filter). They are sorted with no dates, so a refresh with nothing new rewrites nothing, and they go through the existing refreshViews ownership/pruning, so nothing user-authored is touched. Links only point at notes that are written (Facts/, Facts/Pending/, Views/Entities/).

Tests are in node-bot/test/memory-views.test.js; I did not run them locally, CI will.
interface: The merged change for PR #1397 is covered by test/memory-views.test.js, test/server-routes.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
